description: Bug report from a user of agent-harness: Codex runs never get complete usage. codex-cli 0.160 reports cache writes in each turn.completed event, for example {"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 500, "cached_input_tokens": 300, "cache_write_input_tokens": 25, "output_tokens": 40}}, but execution._codex_report always returns cache_write_tokens None. Find the problem and fix it. Change src/agent_harness/ only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = agent-harness e48a7f5^ (src, docs, tests, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, LICENSE, README, pyproject, .gitignore) plus the task-owned helper bench_fixtures/cx.py; no repository history
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_agent_cli (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: agent-harness commit e48a7f5 (fix(execution): probe codex sandbox with the 0.160 syntax and count codex cache writes, 2026-10-10); reference/good.patch is that commit's src/ diff (its sandbox-probe part is not exercised); symptom-only description (one turn with the new field); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark (2026-10-18): sums over turns, a zero count, a failed turn, and guards where one turn lacks the field (unknown, ADR 0002) or an older CLI reports none; malformed write counts and turns without cached_input_tokens are excluded as ambiguous; the fix commit changes no ADR, only a work packet; other reference patches built by build_task.py. Public repository: contamination possible
